subject: general
question:
Match the following:

 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
**A**

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
**B**

 
 
 

 
 
i.

 
 
 
red cabbage leaves

 
 
 
a.

 
 
 
olfactory indicator

 
 
 

 
 
ii.

 
 
 
methyl orange

 
 
 
b.

 
 
 
acid base indictor

 
 
 

 
 
iii.

 
 
 
Onion, clove

 
 
 
c.

 
 
 
natural acid base indictor

options.text: i - c, ii - a, iii - b
i - c, ii - b, iii - a
i - a, ii - b, iii - c
i - a, ii - c, iii - b

solution:
The correct answer is *__**i - c, ii - b, iii - a.**__*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Red cabbage leaves** contain a pigment called anthocyanin, which changes color in response to changes in pH. This makes it a **natural acid base indicator**. Hence, i matches with c.
 
• **Methyl orange** is a synthetic indicator commonly used in titrations because it changes color at a pH range of 3.1 to 4.4. It is an **acid base indicator**. Hence, ii matches with b.
 
• **Onion and clove** are used as **olfactory indicators** in chemistry to detect the presence of acids or bases by their smell. Hence, iii matches with a.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Natural Acid Base Indicator:**__

 __
 
• Natural indicators are substances found in nature that change color when they come in contact with an acid or a base. Examples include red cabbage juice, turmeric, and litmus.
 
• Red cabbage leaves contain anthocyanin, which can indicate pH changes by changing colors.
 
 
 
• **Acid Base Indicator:**__
 __
 
• Acid-base indicators are substances that change color in response to changes in pH, which makes them useful for determining the acidity or basicity of a solution.
 
• Methyl orange is an example of a synthetic acid-base indicator that changes color at different pH levels.
 
 
 
• **Olfactory Indicator:**__
 
 
• Olfactory indicators are substances that change their smell in the presence of an acid or a base. They are used to detect the presence of acids and bases through the sense of smell.
 
• Onion and clove are examples of olfactory indicators.
